# PROCESS — cand_0002 (built on seed; cand_0001 was rejected & reverted)

Strategy: cand_0001 shipped a large batch (payment auto-correct + enriched RETURN values on
all four write tools + "execute promptly" prose) and was REJECTED (0.400→0.267, nothing
crossed 2·SE — a broad variance/behavior-drift loss, not one broken task). Lesson taken:
changing tool RETURN structures and silently rewriting write inputs perturbs the flaky tasks
globally. This iteration ships ONLY provably-correct, bounded, additive edits that are no-ops
on currently-passing trajectories and never change a write tool's return shape.

## Ranked issue list (champion = seed; re-clustered from THIS iteration's ./trajectories/)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrong reservation / flight selected | 22, 8, (17,11,37 reinforce) | agent acts on a reservation/flight that doesn't match the route the user described (task22 ALWAYS picks UM3OG5 SEA→DFW instead of FQ8APE EWR→ORD=NY→Chicago) | KNOWLEDGE | additive policy procedure (match route→reservation) |
| 2 | Passenger-change over-refusal | 40 | agent invents a DOB/identity-verification gate for a simple name change and transfers to human instead of doing it; or submits only the changed passenger (count mismatch) | KNOWLEDGE | policy clarification + docstring + actionable error |
| 3 | Baggage non-free miscount | 22 (+generalizes) | agent marks every bag paid (nonfree=3 for 3 free bags) → wrong DB nonfree + bogus charge; also a mistyped payment id blocks a $0 change | BEHAVIORAL | in-body recompute of nonfree + skip payment when $0 |
| 4 | Unactionable "Payment method not found" | 22 (+generalizes) | id typo (gift_card_8190033 vs …0333) raises a dead-end error with no valid options | KNOWLEDGE | enriched actionable error listing valid ids |
| — | Payment split on book (25,23), COMMUNICATE $ amount (11), flow stalls (37,19) | 25,23,11,37,19 | miscomputed split / omitted refund figure / premature stop | mixed | SKIPPED this round (see below) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | in-body computation | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` | recompute `nonfree = max(0, total − free_allowance(membership,cabin)×n_pax)` from the policy table; nonfree is a DERIVED value, never a free choice, so this equals gold whenever `total` is right | yes — no-op on 12 & 17 (both already yield 0) |
| 3 | in-body guard | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` | only validate/charge a payment when `total_price>0`; a within-allowance change is free and must succeed even with a wrong/unneeded payment_id | yes — 12/17 charge $0 both before & after |
| 4 | enriched error | tools.py `book_reservation`, `update_reservation_baggages`, `update_reservation_flights` | "Payment method X not found" now lists the user's valid payment ids; fires on the error path only | yes — valid-id calls never hit it |
| 2 | docstring + enriched error | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | docstring says submit the COMPLETE list (same count, copy unchanged + their DOB); count-mismatch error now lists current passengers | yes — correct full-list calls unaffected (17/22 pass single pax as before) |
| 2 | additive policy | policy.md "Change passengers" | name/DOB change is permitted, needs no invented verification/transfer; fetch existing passengers via get_reservation_details and resubmit full list; generic worked example (John/Jane Doe) | yes — no passing task refuses a passenger change |
| 1 | additive policy | policy.md "Modify flight" locate step | when a reservation is described by route/cities/date, enumerate reservations and match origin/destination before acting; generic worked example (SFO→BOS) | yes — task 12 gives the id, procedure doesn't apply |

## Verify-the-fix (ran against the live airline DB with the edited tools)
- baggage task22: FQ8APE econ 1pax total=3 nonfree=3 payment='gift_card_WRONG' → nonfree=0, NO error, no new charge. ✓
- baggage no-op task12: YAX4DR gold econ 2pax total=2 nonfree=0 → nonfree=0, payment_history delta 0. ✓
- baggage no-op task17: FQ8APE econ 1pax total=3 nonfree=0 → nonfree=0, delta 0. ✓
- baggage charge path intact: regular econ 1pax total=3 nonfree=99 → recomputed nonfree=2, charges $100. ✓
- passenger mismatch task40: submit 1 of 2 → raises "…has 2 passenger(s)…submit the COMPLETE list…Current passengers:[…]". ✓
- passenger correct full list task40: [Anya Garcia, Mei Garcia] → succeeds, both stored. ✓
- payment-not-found book (sophia): bad id → error lists her 4 real payment ids. ✓
- payment-not-found update_flights (M20IZO): bad id → lists 3 real ids; VALID id credit_card_9074831 → still upgrades to business, charges 1194 (no-op on the valid path). ✓
- Full toolset after edits = 14 default airline tools, unchanged (no add/remove). ✓

## Process & features used
- Serial (no subagents): diagnosis was tractable directly — extracted gold `evaluation_criteria`
  from tau2 tasks.json and the agent's actual write-tool calls+errors from each trajectory, then
  verified every edit against the live DB. This gave argument-level ground truth (e.g. task22's
  wrong-reservation root cause) that the summary feedback alone did not.
- Read ./prior_iterations/cand_0001/{PROCESS,diff.patch} + JOURNAL RESULT: cand_0001's loss was
  broad (no 2·SE break) → attributed to enriched RETURNS + silent write auto-correct + the
  "execute promptly" rule. I did NOT re-try any of those: no return-shape changes, no payment
  auto-correct, no confirmation-flow prose. I kept only cand_0001's provably-correct ideas in a
  minimal form (baggage nonfree recompute, which was E5 there) and dropped the rest.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Write tools must keep returning a bare Reservation (do NOT re-add enriched dict returns — that
  is the most likely cause of cand_0001's variance loss).
- `nonfree_baggages` recompute is policy-exact and a no-op on correct inputs — keep it.
- Actionable errors (list valid options) are pure error-path wins — keep/extend them.

## Deliberately skipped
- Payment-split auto-correct on book (tasks 25/23): the "amount does not add up" error already
  lets the agent recover to the right split; task 25's flaky failures are from wrong flights /
  spurious transfer, NOT the split — auto-correct wouldn't fix them and reintroduces cand_0001's
  rejected write-mutation. Skipped.
- COMMUNICATE exact $ figure (task 11 '5244'): would need a return-shape change (cand_0001's
  rejected lever). Skipped.
- Flow stalls / premature stop (37, 19) and the hugely task-specific 3-booking split (23):
  reasoning/flow failures with no safe general code or additive-knowledge fix. Skipped.
- TitleCase/`Insurance`/`Payment Methods` kwargs: agent self-corrects on retry; intercepting needs
  signature/schema widening (risky). Skipped (cand_0001 also skipped it).
